chunks.embedding_text: Document:AT6132S AT12132S Installation Manual Chapter:Important Safety Information Before Installation - SWING GATE PREPARATION Title:Before Installation - SWING GATE PREPARATION Important Safety Information: Before Installation - Swing Gate Preparation SWING GATE PREPARATION: Do not attach wheels to the gate. Ensure that the gate is plumb, level, and swings freely on its hinges without binding or dra
chunks.content_en: SWING GATE PREPARATION: Do not attach wheels to the gate. Ensure that the gate is plumb, level, and swings freely on its hinges without binding or dragging on the ground. The gate should be mounted to a very stable post or column that is secured in the ground with concrete. If the post’s width or diameter is under 15cm (6"), it should be either metal or set in cement. This ensures stability and minimizes the twisting effect caused by gate movement.

chunks.embedding_text: Document:AT6132S AT12132S Installation Manual Chapter:Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting 3 Attach the Brackets to the Gate Opener Arm Title:Attach the Brackets to the Gate Opener Arm Pull-to-Open 拉式开门 拉开门 内开 inward opening 非推开门 Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting - STEP 3: Attach Brackets to Gate Opener Arm. Connect post bracket assembly and gate bracket with clevis pin and hairpin clip. 将后支架组件和门支架通过插入开口销连接到开门器臂。使用发夹夹固定开口销。
chunks.content_zh: 将后支架组件和门支架通过插入开口销连接到开门器臂。使用发夹夹固定开口销。
chunks.content_en: Attach the post bracket assembly and the gate bracket to the gate opener arm by inserting a clevis pin. Secure the clevis pin using the hairpin clip.

chunks.content_en: Insert the manual release key, and turn it 90° clockwise. The gate opener is now in manual mode, allowing for manual extension and retraction of the moving rod.

images.caption: 释放离合器的示意图，显示了插入手动释放钥匙并顺时针旋转90°。

chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · 5 Position the Gate Opener on the Gate
chunks.question: Position the Gate Opener on the Gate
chunks.embedding_text: Document:AT6132S AT12132S Installation Manual Chapter:Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting 5 Position the Gate Opener on the Gate Title:Position the Gate Opener on the Gate Pull-to-Open 拉式开门 拉开门 内开 inward opening 非推开门 Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting - STEP 5: Position Gate Opener on Gate. Clamp arm to gate post, ensure full retraction, use level and C-clamp. 将开门器臂连同后支架组件夹到门柱上标记的位置。确保开门器臂完全缩回，并且门完全打开到所需位置。将水平仪放在臂上，然后使用C型夹将门支架固定到门上，当臂水平时。
chunks.content_zh: 将开门器臂连同后支架组件夹到门柱上标记的位置。确保开门器臂完全缩回，并且门完全打开到所需位置。将水平仪放在臂上，然后使用C型夹将门支架固定到门上，当臂水平时。
chunks.content_en: Clamp the gate opener arm along with the post bracket assembly to the marked position on the gate post. Make sure that the gate opener arm is fully retracted and the gate is fully opened to the desired position. Put a level on the arm, then use a C-clamp to secure the gate bracket onto the gate when the arm is level.

images.caption: 将开门器放置在门上的示意图，展示了后支架组件、门柱、水平仪和门支架的安装位置，以及开门状态。

chunks.content_en:
STEP 6
Test Gate Travel and Mark the Brackets Mounting Locations
Manually open and close the gate to ensure that the gate bracket position is correct.
Ensure that there is a minimum clearance of 2.5cm (1") between the gate and the opener.
Make sure that the gate opener does not bind against the pull-to-open bracket.
If the clearance is less than 2.5cm (1"), or if the gate opener and the pull-to-open bracket are binding, rotate the pull-to-open bracket and/or move the post bracket assembly.
Mark the center of the mounting locations for the brackets.
NOTE: This step is very important for determining the position of the gate opener arm and the gate opening angle. It is highly recommended to watch our step-by-step installation video on YouTube for guidance.
STEP 7
Drill Bracket Mounting Holes
Remove the C-clamps and the gate opener arm.
Drill 10.5mm (0.4") diameter holes through the post and the gate at the marked locations.

Illustration showing drilling holes for bracket mounting.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information
chunks.question: Important Safety Information
chunks.content_zh:
重要安全信息
安装期间
安装人员和最终用户责任：有经验的安装人员应执行安装。不正确的安装可能导致财产损失、严重伤害或死亡。开门机只是整个开门系统的一部分，安装人员和最终用户有责任确保整个系统安全用于预期用途。
断开电源：确保在进行电气连接或任何调整之前关闭开门机电源。
避免夹伤区域：让儿童、宠物或牲畜远离夹伤区域，以避免受伤或死亡的风险。
安装在财产边界内：将开门机安装在财产内部。不要将其安装在公众可以接触到的门外。
安装安全传感器：开门机设计用于在门与障碍物接触时停止并反转。在以下安全情况下，强烈建议安装光电传感器：如果您的财产有儿童或宠物，开门机自动关闭功能设置为开启，开门机失速力设置为最大，安装了车辆出口传感器，或使用了其他开门控制设备。
门控制附件放置：供用户激活的门控制附件必须放置在距离门的任何移动部分至少1.5米（5英尺）的地方，并且用户无法越过、穿过、绕过门或通过门操作控制。室外或易于接近的控制装置应具有安全功能，以防止未经授权的使用。
安装后
警示标志：将提供的警示标志贴在门的两侧，以提醒公众注意自动开门系统。如果您的标志损坏，请联系TOPENS客户支持更换。
远离移动的门：让儿童、宠物和牲畜远离开门机系统，因为移动的门可能很危险。

chunks.content_en:
Important Safety Information
During Installation
INSTALLER AND END USER RESPONSIBILITY: An experienced installer should perform the installation. Improper installation may result in property damage, severe injury or death. The gate opener is only part of the entire gate operating system, and it is the responsibility of the installer and end user to ensure that the total system is safe for its intended use.
DISCONNECT THE POWER SUPPLY: Ensure that the gate opener is powered off before electrical wire connections or making any adjustments.
AVOID ENTRAPMENT ZONES: Keep children, pets or livestock away from the entrapment zones to avoid the risk of injury or death.
INSTALL INSIDE PROPERTY BOUNDARIES: Install the gate opener on the inside of the property. Do not install outside of the gate where the public has access to it.
INSTALL SAFETY SENSOR: The gate opener is designed to stop and reverse the gate when the gate comes in contact with an obstruction. It is highly recommended to install a photocell sensor in the following situations for safety: if you have children or pets at your property, the gate opener auto close function is set to ON, the gate opener stall force is set to the maximum, a vehicle exit sensor is installed, or other gate control devices are used.
GATE CONTROL ACCESSORIES PLACEMENT: Gate control accessories intended for user activation must be located at least 1.5 meters (5') away from any moving part of the gate and where the user is prevented from reaching over, under, around or through the gate to operate the controls. Outdoor or easily accessible controls shall have a security feature to prevent unauthorized use.
After Installation
WARNING SIGNS: Attach the provided warning signs to both sides of the gate to alert the public about the automatic gate opener system. If your signs are damaged, please reach out to TOPENS Customer Support for replacements.
AWAY FROM MOVING GATES: Keep children, pets and livestock away from the gate opener system as moving gates can be dangerous.
SECURE GATE CONTROL ACCESSORIES: Prevent children from operating gate controls by keeping remote transmitters, keypads, and push buttons out of their reach. Store in a secure area when not in use.
MAINTENANCE OF GATE OPENER SYSTEM: Regularly maintain the gate and gate opener system to ensure that the gate swings freely and remains level throughout

chunks.content_zh:
电池应防水，或应放置在防水外壳中。
UPS01电源支持的最大太阳能电池板功率为240W，超过此限制可能会损坏UPS01电源。

如果每天日照超过6小时且未连接任何配件（光电传感器、电锁、按钮和警示灯除外），开门机每天可运行10个循环。

chunks.content_en:
The batteries should be waterproof, or they should be placed in waterproof housing.
The UPS01 power supply supports a maximum solar panel power of 240W, exceeding this limit can cause damage to the UPS01 power supply.
If the gate opener is solely powered by battery and utilizes the solar panel for charging, a minimum of a 24VDC 12Ah automotive/marine type battery and a 24V 20W solar panel are required.
If there are more than 6 hours of sunlight per day and no accessories are connected (except for the photocell sensor, electric lock, push button, and warning light), the gate opener can operate 10 cycles per day.
Add more solar panels and increase battery capacity if there is less than 6 hours of sunlight per day or if using any accessories (such as an external receiver, exit wand, or wired keypad).
For precise recommendations on solar panel power and battery capacity, please contact our customer support at www.topens.com.

Please repeat the above steps until the gate reaches and automatically stops at the desired closed position. Then tighten the screw firmly.

chunks.content_en:

Make sure that the moving rod is fully retracted when the gate is in the fully closed position before adjusting the limit switch.

If the gate opens over the desired open position, press the remote control to stop the gate opener. Use a screwdriver to loosen the screw of the limit B, slightly slide the limit switch B inwards.
If the gate opens halfway and fails to get to the desired open position, slightly slide the limit switch B outwards.
Please repeat the above steps until the gate reaches and automatically stops at the desired open position. Then tighten the screw firmly.

The appropriate stall force setting will depend on the gate's length and weight, so fine-tuning may be required. Follow these steps to adjust the stall force:
◆ Initial Assessment: Use the remote control to open and close the gate and observe its movement.
◆ Adjust the Stall Force: If the gate reverses or stops before reaching the fully open or close position, increase the stall force by turning the FORCE Potentiometer slightly clockwise.
◆ Perform the Obstruction Test: Run the test after every force setting adjustment (see below).

◆ 操作门：使用遥控器打开和关闭门，确保门在正确的打开和关闭极限位置停止。
◆ 测试设置：在门的路径中放置一个坚固、不可移动的物体，以模拟障碍物。
◆ 测试门关闭和打开：将门朝障碍物关闭方向运行，并以门朝打开方向移动的方式进行相同的测试。

chunks.content_en:
This test ensures that the gate opener’s automatic obstruction sensing feature is functioning correctly. The gate should have enough force to reach both the open and close limits, but MUST reverse after contacting with a solid object.
◆ Operate the Gate: Open and close the gate with the remote control, ensuring that the gate stops at the proper open and close limit positions.
◆ Setup for the Test: Place a solid, immovable object in the gate’s path to simulate an obstruction.
◆ Test Gate Closure and Opening: Run the gate in the closing direction towards the obstruction and conduct the same test with the gate moving in the opening direction.

chunks.content_zh:

编程与操作：
按下并释放控制板上的CODE SW按钮。CODE LED将亮起，表示开门机现在处于编程模式。

TEW3 Vehicle Sensor Exit Wand Opens the gate automatically when senses an approaching car. Wire Connection: Connect the BLACK wire to the control boa
chunks.content_en:
TEW3 Vehicle Sensor Exit Wand Opens the gate automatically when senses an approaching car.

Wire Connection:
Connect the BLACK wire to the control board terminal ⑤ “COM”.
Connect the BLUE wire to the control board terminal ⑥ “OPSW”.
Connect the RED wire to the control board terminal ⑪ “BAT+”.
Connect the GREEN wire to the control board terminal ⑫ “BAT-”.

Key Installation Notes: Install the wand 7.5m to 30m (25ft. to 100ft.) away from the gate, and bury it 5cm (2") deep from ground and 20cm (8") from th
chunks.content_en:
Key Installation Notes:
Install the wand 7.5m to 30m (25ft. to 100ft.) away from the gate, and bury it 5cm (2") deep from ground and 20cm (8") from the driveway edge.
Install the wand away from any power lines to avoid interrupting the detection signal.

chunks.content_zh:
防止门在受阻时关闭，通过简单的接线增加安全性。

接线说明
将“10-25VAC/12-30VDC”端子连接到控制板端子 1 “+24” 和端子 3 “GND”，不分电线极性。将“NC”端子连接到控制板端子 2 “PHOTO”。将“COM”端子连接到控制板端子 3 “GND”。
将拨码开关 #5 设置为 ON 以启用光电传感器功能。

关键安装注意事项
将光电传感器安装在离地面至少 20 厘米 (8 英寸) 的位置。
给开门机通电。将反射器直接放置在已安装的光电传感器对面。按下遥控器后，光电传感器工作灯变为绿色，确认反射器位置正确。
光电传感器的最大感应范围为 10 米 (33 英尺)。

注意：接线需要一根 4 芯 x 0.3 平方毫米 (22AWG) 的电缆，但包装内不包含该电缆。
chunks.content_en:
Prevents the gate from closing when obstructed, adds security with simple wire connection.

Wire Connection
Connect “10-25VAC/12-30VDC” terminals to the control board terminal 1 “+24” and terminal 3 “GND”, regardless of the polarity of the wires. Connect “NC” terminal to the control board terminal 2 “PHOTO”. Connect “COM” terminal to the control board terminal 3 “GND”.
Set the DIP switch #5 to ON to enable the photocell sensor function.

Key Installation Notes
Mount the photocell sensor at least 20cm (8”) above the ground.
Power on the gate opener. Position the reflector directly opposite the mounted photocell sensor. With a press of the remote control, the photocell sensor working light turns to green, confirming that the reflector is in the correct position.
The maximum sensing range of the photocell sensor is 10m (33ft. ).

NOTE: A 4C x 0.3 mm² (22AWG) cable is required for the wire connection, but it is NOT included.

Put the cables into PVC conduit and bury the conduit underground to prevent damage.

chunks.content_en:
Inspect the Gate: Check for any signs of damage, rust, or wear on the gate and hinges.
Check Gate Opener Arm: Check that the arm is securely attached to both the gate and post brackets. Tighten any loose bolts and screws.
Examine Cables and Wires: Ensure that all cables and wires are intact, without any cuts or frays.

chunks.question: Gate Opener Status Trouble Shooting
chunks.content_en:
One Gate Runs Normally but the Other One Does Not Move

STATUS OF THE LEDS
CODE LED: Flash (1 Blink every second)
POWER LED: Flash (1 Blink every second)
FULL LED: Flash (1 Blink every second)

POSSIBLE SOLUTION
Step 1 Exchange Arm Connections: Swap the wire connections of the two gate opener arms on the control board. If the same arm remains faulty, the issue is with the arm itself. If the issue moves to the other arm, the problem is likely with the control board.
Step 2 Test the Faulty Arm Motor: Connect the RED and BLACK wires of the faulty arm directly to the output of the UPS01 power supply to check if the arm operates normally. Switching the polarity (by swapping RED and BLACK wires) will reverse the arm’s direction. If the arm does not run, the motor inside the arm is faulty. If the arm runs in both directions, proceed to Step 3.
Step 3 Check the Limit Switch: Ensure that the “+BAT-” terminals on the control board are connected to the LOAD output wires of the UPS01 power supply. Reconnect the RED and BLACK wires of the faulty arm back to the control board. Disconnect the BLUE, GREEN, and YELLOW wires of the faulty arm from the control board. Use two jumper wires to short the ULT, COM & DLT terminals to which the wires were connected, and then press the remote to see if the arm can extend and retract. During this test, monitor the arm to ensure it doesn’t extend too far. Use the remote to reverse the direction if necessary. If the arm can move in both directions, the limit switch is faulty.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · 1 Check the Gate
chunks.question: Check the Gate
chunks.embedding_text: Document:AT6132S AT12132S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin 1 Check the Gate Title:Check the Gate Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Check the Gate Ensure gate is plumb, level, swings freely. Mount gate to stable post/column with concrete. Repair/replace worn/damaged hardware before installation.
chunks.content_en:
Ensure that the gate is plumb, level, and swings freely on its hinges without binding or dragging on the ground.
The gate should be mounted to a very stable post or column that is secured in the ground with concrete.
Repair or replace all worn or damaged gate hardware prior to installation.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · 3 Battery Required
chunks.question: Battery Required
chunks.embedding_text: Document:AT6132S AT12132S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin 3 Battery Required Title:Battery Required Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Battery Required For battery/solar power: 24V 12Ah battery (not included) required. Marine/automotive, lead acid/GEL/AGM/flooded deep cycle batteries supported (EXCEPT lithium-ion). Batteries must be waterproof or in waterproof housing. Two 10W solar panels included; additional TOPENS solar panel kit available separately.
chunks.content_en:
If you choose to use batteries and solar panels as main power source, you'll require 24V 12Ah battery (NOT included).
Marine / automotive type battery or lead acid / GEL / AGM / flooded (deep cycle battery) batteries are supported, EXCEPT for lithium-ion battery.
The batteries should be waterproof, or they should be placed in waterproof housing.
Two 10W solar panels are included. If additional solar panel is needed, TOPENS solar panel kit is available for separate purchase.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · 4 Items Not Included but May Needed
chunks.question: Items Not Included but May Needed
chunks.embedding_text: Document:AT6132S AT12132S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin 4 Items Not Included but May Needed Title:Items Not Included but May Needed Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Items Not Included but May Needed PVC Conduit (for slave arm/photocell sensor cables), Connection Cable (for wired accessories, see manual), Weatherproof Cover (for outdoor outlets), Surge Protector (5A, for UPS01 power supply).
chunks.content_en:
PVC Conduit: Required to protect the extension cable connecting the slave arm to the control board and the cable connecting TC102 infrared photocell sensor to the control board.
Connection Cable: Connection cable may be required for installing wired accessories. Refer to the Connection of Accessories section in this manual to purchase the correct cable.
Weatherproof Cover: Use a weatherproof cover to protect the electrical outlet if it is located outdoors.
Surge Protector: A surge protector with a rated current of 5A is recommended to use with the UPS01 power supply.

chunks.content_en: In windy areas, it is crucial to use an electric gate lock to ensure the gate remains securely closed and to prevent damage or malfunction caused by strong winds.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · 6 Install Photocell Sensor
chunks.question: Install Photocell Sensor
chunks.embedding_text: Document:AT6132S AT12132S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin 6 Install Photocell Sensor Title:Install Photocell Sensor Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Install Photocell Sensor Install a photocell sensor for safety if: children/pets are present, auto close is ON, stall force is maximum, a vehicle exit sensor is installed, or other gate control devices are used.
chunks.content_en: It is highly recommended to install a photocell sensor in the following situations for safety: if you have children or pets at your property, the gate opener auto close function is set to ON, the gate opener stall force is set to the maximum, a vehicle exit sensor is installed, or other gate control devices are used.

chunks.embedding_text: Document:AT6132S AT12132S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin 1 Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability Title:Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability. Wooden post, concrete post, metal plate, washer, expansion bolts, post width/diameter. 确保用于将支架固定到木柱上的螺栓足够长，能够穿过整个木柱。 在螺栓和木柱之间添加金属板或更大的垫圈，以提高支架的稳定性。 对于混凝土柱，使用膨胀螺栓牢固地安装支架。 如果立柱的宽度或直径小于15厘米（6英寸），则应为金属立柱或用水泥固定。
chunks.content_zh:
确保用于将支架固定到木柱上的螺栓足够长，能够穿过整个木柱。
在螺栓和木柱之间添加金属板或更大的垫圈，以提高支架的稳定性。
对于混凝土柱，使用膨胀螺栓牢固地安装支架。
如果立柱的宽度或直径小于15厘米（6英寸），则应为金属立柱或用水泥固定。
chunks.content_en:
Ensure that the bolts used to attach post bracket to wooden post are long enough to pass through the entire post.
Add metal plate or larger washer between the bolt and the wooden post to improve bracket stability.
For concrete post, use expansion bolts to securely mount the bracket.
If the post’s width or diameter is under 15cm (6”), it should be either metal or set in cement.
